notes: Independently read all 28 eligible production TS files, package.json and openclaw.plugin.json. All 52 plugin files are explicitly partitioned; no eligible declaration files or generated/build exceptions exist in this source tree.

Production relative imports remain within extensions/agentsapi. The eligible native-session-binding-api.ts barrel reexports plugin-owned readRecord, not an SDK symbol. No additional plugin-owned/shared shipped source outside the root is imported. SDK implementations and installed openai/zod dependencies are outside this audit boundary.

The package declares index.ts as its extension entry. Source scope also includes native-session-binding-api.ts and all eligible helpers regardless of entrypoint reachability. Published-artifact coverage is not claimed.

Resolved public specifiers and original exported names against package.json exports and their src/plugin-sdk facades. SDK aliases inside those facades (for example embeddedAgentLog and abortAndDrainAgentHarnessRun) retain the names publicly imported by this plugin.

definePluginEntry types its register callback through OpenClawPluginDefinition.register/OpenClawPluginApi. index.ts forwards api.runtime unchanged into the PluginRuntime-typed harness and binding helpers. The only consumed public runtime paths are config.current, agent.resolveAgentDir, agent.resolveAgentWorkspaceDir, and state.openKeyedStoreV2; the bare handle propagation adds no root/prefix finding.

Harness params, hostCapabilities, executor controller, SessionManager instances, state stores, lifecycle objects, native API clients, projections, returned config objects, and SDK helper return values are separate contracts or plugin-owned objects, not OpenClawPluginApi/PluginRuntime handles. Their members and SDK helper internal effects are not enumerated as API/runtime members.

runAgentHarnessLlmOutputHook/runAgentHarnessAfterToolCallHook/agent-end helper invocations are SDK function dependencies, not API on/registerHook registrations. No named hook registrations occur. Manifest activation.onAgentHarnesses/categories/configSchema describe discovery/configuration and are not agreed manifest-contract fields; this manifest has no channels/providers/skills/commandAliases/cliCommands/contracts declarations.

Type syntax is preserved: agentHarnessAttemptTerminal, setActiveEmbeddedRun, SessionManager, readMediaBuffer, extractMessagingToolSend, createAgentHarnessToolExecutionBoundaryRegistry, and readAsyncStartedTaskIds have ordinary value imports plus explicit type use and are mixed exports. Their module classifications follow only import sites. FsSafeError is imported and used in instanceof, with no constructor invocation; imported constants remain import-only.

agentsapi-files.ts directly destructures prepareAgentWorkspaceAttachments from a dynamic SDK import; this resolves the named export without an un-narrowed namespace binding. Local wrapper calls do not acquire transitive SDK call kinds.

Repository caller search verified the five ambiguous test-only API/helper files. native-session-binding.test-api.ts uses Vitest spies and is loaded by storage/deletion tests, including the separately test-only session-native-binding.test-support.ts; no production callers override exclusions.
